title: The Dutch Golden Age
description: Light, intimacy, and virtuosity from the 17th-century Netherlands.
source: Rijksmuseum, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Aristotle with a Bust of Homer
items.description_narrative: A man in a dark tunic and full white sleeves rests one hand gently on the head of a marble bust, a heavy gold chain crossing his chest and a wide black hat shading his face. The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates this painting to 1653.
items.tags: portrait, gold chain, marble bust, chiaroscuro, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Portrait of a Man ("The Auctioneer")
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a dark, fur-trimmed robe and broad-brimmed hat holds a sheaf of papers, his gaze steady and appraising. Deep shadow envelops the room around him, leaving only his face, hands, and a pale cuff caught in warm light.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, man with papers, fur trim, broad hat, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Herman Doomer (ca. 1595–1650)
items.description_narrative: A man with a thin mustache and goatee looks out from beneath a wide black hat, a crisply pleated white ruff framing his neck above a plain brown coat. The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates this portrait to 1640.
items.tags: portrait, ruff collar, wide-brimmed hat, dutch golden age, oil on wood, dark background
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Portrait of Gerard de Lairesse
items.description_narrative: A young man with long curling hair and a broad-brimmed hat holds a sheaf of papers loosely in both hands, his fur-trimmed cloak catching warm light against a shadowed interior.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, young man, fur-trimmed cloak, papers, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: Wearing a dark beret and a mustard-brown robe, a man with a lined face and steady gaze looks directly out at the viewer, one hand resting against a round object tucked at his side.
items.tags: self-portrait, rembrandt, beret, dutch golden age, direct gaze, metropolitan museum
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Hendrickje Stoffels (1626–1663)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark, richly textured cloak rests one hand lightly at her chest, her gaze lowered in quiet thought against an almost entirely dark background, warm light catching only her face and hands. The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates this portrait to the mid-1650s.
items.tags: portrait, chiaroscuro, quiet pose, dutch golden age, oil on canvas, dark background
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Man in a Turban
items.description_narrative: An elderly man in a voluminous grey silk turban, fastened with a jeweled brooch and tassel, wears a gold-embroidered robe beneath a heavy fur-trimmed cloak. The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates this portrait to 1632.
items.tags: portrait, turban, fur-trimmed cloak, dutch golden age, oil on canvas, rich fabric
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Lucas van Uffel (died 1637)
items.description_narrative: Turning to face the viewer, a man in a black robe with a delicate lace collar rests one hand on a chair back, a pair of dividers in the other; a marble bust and a terrestrial globe sit on the draped table behind him. The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates this portrait to about 1622.
items.tags: portrait, globe, marble bust, lace collar, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: A Maid Asleep
items.description_narrative: A woman dozes at a table with her head propped on one hand, a jug and a basket of fruit spilling across a richly patterned carpet in front of her, an open doorway leading to another sunlit room beyond. Vermeer painted this scene around 1656.
items.tags: sleeping figure, interior scene, still life, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Study of a Young Woman
items.description_narrative: A young woman turns her head to meet the viewer's gaze, a pale blue-grey wrap draped loosely over her shoulders and a tan scarf trailing behind her. She emerges from an almost featureless dark background, lit softly from one side.
items.tags: portrait, vermeer, young woman, dark background, soft light, dutch golden age, metropolitan museum
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: The Crucifixion with the Virgin and Saint John
items.description_narrative: A pale figure hangs on the cross above a skull and scattered bones, a grieving woman in rose and grey clasping her hands at left while a younger man in red and green looks upward at right. Hendrick ter Brugghen painted this crucifixion scene around 1625.
items.tags: religious painting, crucifixion, chiaroscuro, hendrick ter brugghen, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Young Man and Woman in an Inn
items.description_narrative: Frans Hals painted this genre portrait in 1623; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art. A laughing man in a wide, feathered hat raises a glass overhead while a smiling woman rests her hand on his shoulder, a small dog nestled at her side.
items.tags: frans hals, dutch golden age, genre painting, portrait, oil painting, tavern scene, 17th century, met museum
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Boy with a Lute
items.description_narrative: A boy in a dark beret grins over his shoulder, one hand raised mid-gesture, cradling a lute against a red sleeve while an orange and small ball rest on the table before him. This portrait, painted around 1625, is attributed to Frans Hals, though some scholars connect it to Judith Leyster.
items.tags: portrait, musician, lute, laughing, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Petrus Scriverius (1576–1660)
items.description_narrative: Set within a painted oval, an older man with a high forehead and a full, greying beard gazes past the viewer, one hand resting lightly at his chest. A delicately rendered lace ruff frames his face, catching the light against the dark folds of his cloak.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, oval frame, lace ruff, older man, dutch golden age, oil on wood
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: The Smokers
items.description_narrative: A wide-eyed man reacts with an open mouth as he is handed a jug across a crowded tavern table, smoke curling above a huddle of laughing companions. A rustic broom, ceramic jug, and basket clutter the floor in the foreground.
items.tags: genre scene, tavern, smoking, pipe, dutch golden age, drinking scene, flemish genre
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Landschap met stenen brug
items.description_narrative: A low stone bridge arches over a quiet river, small boats with rowers passing beneath it, trees and rooftops clustered along the bank under a sky split between soft daylight and heavy, dark cloud.
items.tags: landscape, stone bridge, river, dramatic sky, dutch golden age, oil on panel

items.title: The Night Watch
items.description_narrative: A militia company spills into the street in a blaze of movement: a captain in black and a lieutenant in gold-and-cream step forward as light falls unevenly across drummers, pikemen, and a small girl in a pale gown glowing at the edge of the crowd. Deep shadow swallows the background, so the group seems to erupt out of darkness.
items.tags: militia, group portrait, chiaroscuro, dutch golden age, civic guard, drummer, dramatic light, baroque

items.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
items.description_narrative: Turning over her shoulder, a young woman meets the viewer's gaze, a blue and gold turban wrapped around her head and a single pearl catching the light at her ear, the background falling away into darkness. Vermeer painted this portrait around 1665.
items.tags: portrait, pearl earring, turban, chiaroscuro, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: The Milkmaid
items.description_narrative: A woman in a yellow bodice and blue apron carefully pours milk from a jug into a bowl, a basket of bread and a small foot warmer nearby, wicker and metal vessels hanging on the plain wall behind her. Vermeer painted this scene around 1660.
items.tags: domestic scene, pouring milk, kitchen, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture — AHrw. Z3. Av6. Zhjg 9. AHrw. Z3. Av6. Zhjg

items.title: View of Delft
items.description_narrative: A walled town rises across still water beneath a vast, dramatically clouded sky, its spires and red-tiled roofs mirrored faintly in the harbor below. Small boats rest at anchor near the shore, where a few figures in dark cloaks pause at the water's edge.
items.tags: cityscape, vermeer, dutch golden age, harbor, clouds, mauritshuis, delft

items.title: Woman Holding a Balance
items.description_narrative: A woman in a fur-trimmed blue jacket and white cap stands quietly at a table scattered with pearls and gold, holding an empty balance scale level between her fingers. Behind her hangs a large, darkly toned painting, its dim figures forming a hazy backdrop to her stillness.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, balance scale, pearls, dutch golden age, interior light, stillness
items.credit_line: -wHFDKu7-mhjtQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
items.description_narrative: A group of men in starched ruffs lean in close around a pale corpse laid out on a table, one man in a broad black hat probing the exposed tendons of its forearm with forceps while the others study the dissection or consult their papers. Rembrandt painted this scene, now in the Mauritshuis.
items.tags: anatomy lesson, group portrait, dissection, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: The Jewish Bride
items.description_narrative: Rendered entirely in fine, cross-hatched black lines, a seated woman with long, loosely flowing hair holds a folded paper, an arched stone doorway sketched in behind her. Rembrandt van Rijn made this etching, worked with drypoint and engraving, in 1634; the Cleveland Museum of Art catalogues it as 'The Great Jewish Bride'.
items.tags: etching, drypoint, monochrome, portrait, rembrandt, dutch golden age

items.title: Winter Landscape with Skaters
items.description_narrative: Dozens of small figures skate, sled, and gather across a frozen waterway lined with thatched cottages and haystacks, a red flag marking one rooftop. A dark bank of cloud looms over one side of the scene, contrasting with pale winter light on the other.
items.tags: landscape, winter, ice skating, dutch golden age, frozen river, genre scene, avercamp circle

items.title: Malle Babbe
items.description_narrative: A woman in a white bonnet and ruff grins with an unrestrained, almost wild expression, a tankard at her elbow and an owl perched on her shoulder. Frans Hals painted this figure around the 1640s.
items.tags: portrait, owl, tankard, expressive, frans hals, dutch golden age

items.title: The Goldfinch
items.description_narrative: A small, red-faced finch perches on a curved feeding trough mounted to a plain wall, a thin chain looped around its leg, painted against a pale, almost bare background. Carel Fabritius signed and dated this small panel in 1654.
items.tags: bird painting, goldfinch, minimalist, carel fabritius, dutch golden age, oil on panel

items.title: The Art of Painting
items.description_narrative: Seen from behind, a painter in a black slashed doublet and red-and-white hose works at his easel, while his model stands near a wall map in a blue dress, holding a book and a long brass horn, a gilded chandelier hanging overhead. Vermeer painted this scene in the 1660s.
items.tags: artist studio, painter, allegory, interior scene, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: The Laughing Cavalier
items.description_narrative: A man in an intricately embroidered black doublet tilts his head with a knowing half-smile beneath a broad black hat, his waxed mustache upturned and a wide lace ruff framing his throat. Frans Hals painted this portrait of Tieleman Roosterman in 1624.
items.tags: portrait, lace ruff, embroidered doublet, smiling, frans hals, dutch golden age

items.title: Belshazzar's Feast
items.description_narrative: A richly turbaned, crowned king recoils mid-gesture at a banquet table, staring up at glowing letters that hang unexplained in the air above him while his startled guests spill wine and clutch at each other. Rembrandt painted this dramatic feast scene around 1635 to 1638.
items.tags: biblical scene, feast, dramatic lighting, turban, rembrandt, dutch golden age
items.credit_line: This file was derived from: Rembrandt-Belsazar.jpg:

items.title: The Courtyard of a House in Delft
items.description_narrative: Through a brick archway, a woman stands in a hallway beyond, while in the foreground courtyard a mother reaches toward a small girl near a wooden shed and a water pail, ivy climbing the weathered brick walls. Pieter de Hooch painted this Delft courtyard in 1658.
items.tags: courtyard, domestic scene, brick architecture, pieter de hooch, dutch golden age, genre painting

items.title: The Young Bull
items.description_narrative: A young bull stands nearly at life size in the foreground, its white-faced companion cow settled at its feet with two sheep dozing nearby, while a farmhand rests a hand against a gnarled tree and a bird wheels overhead. Paulus Potter completed this animal study in 1647, part of the Dutch Golden Age's genre of animal art.
items.tags: bull, cattle, farmhand, pastoral, animal art, dutch golden age, meadow, livestock

items.title: The Abduction of Europa
items.description_narrative: A girl in a golden robe is carried into the surf on the back of a pale animal, twisting back toward the shore where her companions fling up their arms in alarm; an ornate, gilded carriage waits under the trees, a walled city and ships visible across the water. Rembrandt painted this mythological scene, the abduction of Europa by Zeus in the form of a bull, in 1632.
items.tags: mythological painting, abduction, seascape, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on panel
items.credit_line: JwHVmnI-bQWnRw at Google Cultural Institute zoom level scaled down maximum

items.title: Judith at the Banquet of Holofernes (Artemisia)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a gleaming white and gold gown, pearls in her hair, stands with one hand at her chest as an attendant offers her a covered cup, another figure watching from the shadows beside a table draped in patterned red cloth. Rembrandt painted this scene in 1634, its central figure variously identified with Saskia van Uylenburgh, Sophonisba, and Artemisia of Caria.
items.tags: history painting, banquet scene, pearls, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: The Prado in Google Earth: Home page scaled down from highest level of zoom, JPEG compression quality: Photoshop 11.

items.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
items.description_narrative: A ragged, barefoot young man kneels and buries his face against an elderly man's robe, whose weathered hands rest gently on his son's back in a gesture of forgiveness. Three onlookers stand at the edge of the scene, watching in near silence from the shadows.
items.tags: reunion, forgiveness, rembrandt, biblical scene, dutch golden age, dramatic light, kneeling figure, red robe

items.title: Self-Portrait (c. 1659)
items.description_narrative: A man with tousled grey curls and a weathered face wears a dark cap and a plain, worn coat, one shoulder softly lit while the rest of the figure recedes into shadow.
items.tags: self-portrait, rembrandt, grey curls, dutch golden age, dark cap, chiaroscuro
items.credit_line: -gHQe8vbiHn2xw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Landscape with the Good Samaritan
items.description_narrative: A gnarled, wind-bent tree dominates a stormy landscape, dark clouds massing overhead as small figures on horseback move along a path near a distant waterfall and rolling hills. Rembrandt painted this landscape in 1638.
items.tags: landscape, storm clouds, tree, dramatic lighting, rembrandt, dutch golden age

items.title: Portrait of a Seated Woman with Spectacles and a Book
items.description_narrative: An elderly woman sits with a pair of spectacles held loosely in one hand and a small clasped book resting on her lap, her broad pleated collar framing a face turned slightly aside.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, elderly woman, spectacles, book, ruff collar, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro

items.title: Man in Oriental Costume
items.description_narrative: A bearded man wears a feathered, jewel-banded turban and a maroon robe beneath a heavy fur-trimmed cloak, one hand resting at his waist. This portrait, painted around 1635, is attributed to Govert Flink or Rembrandt.
items.tags: portrait, turban, feather plume, fur-trimmed cloak, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: An Old Woman Reading, Probably the Prophetess Hannah
items.description_narrative: Wrapped in a heavy red robe and a gold-threaded headscarf, an elderly woman bends over a large open book, her face lit warmly against deep shadow. She is identified as the prophetess Anna.
items.tags: portrait, elderly woman, reading, rembrandt, biblical figure, chiaroscuro, dutch golden age, book

items.title: Self-Portrait in Oriental Dress
items.description_narrative: A man wears an elaborate dark turban pinned with a jewel and topped by a tall feather, his richly draped cloak fastened at the shoulder with gold braid.
items.tags: self-portrait, rembrandt, turban, feather plume, dutch golden age, costume study, gold braid

items.title: Jacob Blessing the Children of Joseph
items.description_narrative: Propped up in bed, an elderly man rests his hand on the bowed head of a kneeling child while a turbaned man steadies him and a richly dressed woman looks on, a deep red blanket spread across the foreground. Rembrandt painted this biblical scene, Jacob blessing the children of Joseph, in 1656.
items.tags: biblical scene, deathbed blessing, warm lighting, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Young Woman in Profile, with a Fan
items.description_narrative: Turned in strict profile, a young woman with copper-red hair looks to the side, a pearl earring and necklace catching the light against her dark, gold-trimmed gown as she holds a closed fan. Rembrandt painted this portrait in 1632.
items.tags: profile portrait, rembrandt, pearls, fan, dutch golden age, 17th century, portrait

items.title: Portrait of a Clergyman
items.description_narrative: A balding, bearded man in black stands with quiet authority, his starched white ruff catching the light as one hand rests against a pair of gloves tucked at his side. He is identified as Eleazar Swalmius.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, ruff collar, dutch golden age, black robe, clergyman, eleazar swalmius
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Bust of an Old Bearded Man Wearing a Golden Chain with a Cross
items.description_narrative: An elderly man in a dark velvet beret and cloak gazes out from an octagonal panel, his white beard catching the light, a double gold chain looped over his shoulders and ending in a jeweled cross. Rembrandt's workshop painted this bust around 1630.
items.tags: portrait, elderly man, gold chain, octagonal panel, dutch golden age, oil on panel

items.title: Self-Portrait (early)
items.description_narrative: In this small, close-cropped portrait, a young man with a mop of curly reddish-brown hair and a bare hint of white collar turns his face into soft, low light, the rest of the composition dissolving into shadow.
items.tags: self-portrait, rembrandt, young man, curly hair, dutch golden age, small scale, chiaroscuro

items.title: Bellona
items.description_narrative: A woman in polished armor and a plumed helmet stands in three-quarter view, one hand resting on her hip and the other holding a shield bearing a monstrous, snake-haired face. Rembrandt painted this Roman war goddess in 1633, her rich brocade skirt and gold trim catching the light against a dim, arched interior.
items.tags: portrait, mythology, armor, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil painting

items.title: Man in a Fur-Lined Coat
items.description_narrative: A man with long, loosely curling hair wears a fur-trimmed brown coat over a red tunic, a gold chain at his throat and a hat held in one hand as he grips a cane in the other. Rembrandt painted this portrait in 1656.
items.tags: portrait, fur-lined coat, gold chain, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: jAHbl_cGJqdwkg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Saint Paul
items.description_narrative: An older man in a red cap and dark robe sits in shadow, his hands loosely clasped over the edge of pages tucked beneath his arm. He is identified in the collection record as Saint Paul.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, apostle, red cap, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro, national gallery

items.title: Portrait of Margaretha de Geer, Wife of Jacob Trip
items.description_narrative: An elderly woman stands in black with a peaked white cap and a broad pleated ruff, a handkerchief held loosely in one hand while the other rests on a chair beside her. She is identified as Margaretha de Geer.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, elderly woman, ruff collar, national gallery, dutch golden age, margaretha de geer, black gown

items.title: The Laughing Man
items.description_narrative: Framed in a small oval, a man's face breaks into a wide, gap-toothed laugh, his curling hair loose around a metal gorget at his throat. Rembrandt painted this small portrait in 1629.
items.tags: portrait, laughing, gorget, small format, rembrandt, dutch golden age

items.title: Two African Men
items.description_narrative: Two men are shown close together, one smiling faintly as he glances aside, the other resting his head near his companion's shoulder in quiet shadow. Both wear loosely draped cloaks, rendered with broad, visible brushwork typical of a character study.
items.tags: tronie, rembrandt, character study, dutch golden age, mauritshuis, loose brushwork

items.title: Andromeda Chained to the Rocks
items.description_narrative: A nude woman stands with her wrists shackled and raised above her head, her face turned anxiously to one side against a dark rocky outcrop. Rembrandt painted this scene of Andromeda chained to the rocks in 1630.
items.tags: mythological painting, chained figure, nude, dramatic lighting, rembrandt, dutch golden age

items.title: The Abduction of Ganymede
items.description_narrative: A huge dark eagle grips a plump, crying child in its talons and beak, hauling him upward into a churning, stormy sky. Rembrandt painted this unsettling scene of Ganymede's abduction in 1635.
items.tags: mythological painting, eagle, abduction, dramatic, rembrandt, dutch golden age

items.title: Young Woman in Fantasy Costume (Saskia)
items.description_narrative: In this oval bust portrait, a young woman gazes out with a faint smile, her hair swept up beneath a beaded, feathered headdress and a string of pearls at her throat. Rembrandt painted the sitter, traditionally identified as Saskia van Uylenburgh, around 1633.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, saskia, headdress, pearls, dutch golden age, bust portrait

items.title: Portrait of Marten Looten
items.description_narrative: A young man in a broad-brimmed black hat and a crisp white collar presses one hand to his chest while the other holds a folded letter inscribed with fine, looping handwriting.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, young man, black hat, letter, white collar, dutch golden age, lacma

items.title: Minerva
items.description_narrative: A young woman wears an ornate crown and a red cloak trimmed in gold, standing before a dim backdrop where a helmet and shield rest half-hidden in shadow. Rembrandt painted this figure in the 1630s.
items.tags: allegorical portrait, crown, red cloak, dutch golden age, rembrandt, tronie

items.title: Flora (Saskia van Uylenburgh in Arcadian Costume)
items.description_narrative: Crowned with a wreath of greenery, a woman in an embroidered gold and green gown holds a tall staff in one hand and a spray of flowers in the other, set within an elaborately carved gilt frame. Rembrandt painted this costumed portrait in 1635.
items.tags: allegorical portrait, floral wreath, gilt frame, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: The Rape of Proserpina
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale gold gown is hauled backward into a horse-drawn chariot as it plunges toward a churning river, her cry lost against a dramatic, cloud-streaked sky. Attendants grasp at her trailing drapery from the water's edge, straining against the chariot's momentum.
items.tags: mythology, abduction, rembrandt, dramatic sky, dutch golden age, chariot, mythological painting, dramatic light

items.title: Portrait of Aechje Claesdr.
items.description_narrative: Set in an oval frame, an elderly woman in black with a sheer white cap and a wide pleated ruff gazes downward, her lined face softly lit against a warm brown background.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, elderly woman, oval frame, ruff collar, dutch golden age, national gallery, sober palette

items.title: The Apostle Paul
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a dark robe sits with his head resting against his hand, deep in thought, a sword propped against his chair and an open book before him. Rembrandt painted this figure of the Apostle Paul around 1657.
items.tags: religious painting, portrait, contemplative, rembrandt, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington D.C.

items.title: A Woman in Bed
items.description_narrative: A woman reclines against pillows in a loose white shift, one arm raised to draw back a heavy red curtain as she glances toward something unseen. A jeweled band catches the light in her hair, and warm shadow gathers around the bed.
items.tags: portrait, rembrandt, bed, red curtain, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro, scottish national gallery

items.title: The Philosopher
items.description_narrative: This tronie — a character study, not a named portrait — is attributed to the workshop of Rembrandt van Rijn, painted around 1653 in oil on panel and later held in the Charles Sedelmeyer collection. It shows a bearded man in a broad dark hat and gold chain, one hand raised near his chest, against a plain dark background.
items.tags: tronie, dutch golden age, rembrandt workshop, oil on panel, portrait study, chiaroscuro

items.title: Saint Bartholomew
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a plain brown robe rests one arm on the back of a chair, a long knife blade catching the light in his other hand. Deep shadow fills the background, leaving only his weathered face and hands illuminated. He is identified as Bartholomew the Apostle.
items.tags: portrait, apostle, rembrandt, knife, dutch golden age, chiaroscuro, religious figure

items.title: The Girl with the Wine Glass
items.description_narrative: A woman in a shining red satin gown accepts a wine glass from a standing man in a dark cloak and stiff white ruff, while another man slumps at the table behind them, head propped on his hand; a coat of arms glows in a stained-glass window at left. Vermeer painted this scene in 1659.
items.tags: genre scene, wine glass, red dress, stained glass, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: Lady Seated at a Virginal
items.description_narrative: A woman in gleaming teal satin sits at a keyboard instrument, a bass viol and its bow propped against a chair to one side, a gilt-framed painting of figures hanging on the wall behind her. Vermeer painted this scene in the 1670s.
items.tags: musician, virginal, interior scene, satin dress, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: Lady Standing at a Virginal
items.description_narrative: A woman in blue and cream stands beside a keyboard instrument, a small landscape and a larger gilt-framed painting of a cherub hanging above her, a blue upholstered chair and black-and-white tiles filling the room. Vermeer painted this scene in the 1670s.
items.tags: musician, virginal, interior scene, tiled floor, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: The Glass of Wine
items.description_narrative: A standing man in a wide black hat and grey cloak pours wine from a white jug, while a seated woman in salmon pink lifts a glass to her lips beside a table set with a lute; a coat of arms glows in the stained-glass window at left. This work, painted around 1658 to 1660, is attributed to Jan Vermeer van Haarlem the Elder or Johannes Vermeer.
items.tags: genre scene, wine pouring, stained glass, interior, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Girl with the Red Hat
items.description_narrative: A young woman glances over her shoulder from beneath a broad, plush red hat, its brim catching the light. Loose brushwork models her flushed cheeks and parted lips against a shadowy tapestry backdrop. A blue velvet wrap falls loosely from her shoulder, its folds picking up soft highlights.
items.tags: portrait, red hat, tronie, chiaroscuro, dutch golden age
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, Andrew W. Mellon Collection, 1937.1.53 (Open Access)

items.title: The Geographer
items.description_narrative: A man in a loose blue robe leans over a table scattered with charts, a pair of dividers in his hand, a globe resting atop the cabinet behind him and daylight falling through a leaded window. Vermeer painted this scholar in 1668.
items.tags: interior scene, scholar, globe, window light, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: The Guitar Player
items.description_narrative: A woman with ringlet curls and a pearl necklace plucks at a guitar, her yellow fur-trimmed jacket catching the light, a framed landscape painting hanging on the wall behind her and books stacked nearby. Vermeer painted this scene around 1672.
items.tags: musician, guitar, portrait, interior scene, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: Mistress and Maid
items.description_narrative: A woman pauses mid-thought, fingers pressed to her chin, as a maid leans in to offer her a letter, papers scattered across the table between them. The moment feels caught mid-motion, as if whatever she was doing has just been interrupted.
items.tags: genre scene, letter, domestic interior, vermeer, dutch golden age, candlelight, yellow satin, interrupted moment

items.title: Allegory of the Catholic Faith
items.description_narrative: A woman in blue and white sits with one hand pressed to her chest and her foot resting on a globe, gazing upward beneath a painting of the crucifixion, a crucifix and open book on the table beside her. Vermeer painted this allegory in the 1670s.
items.tags: allegory, religious symbolism, interior scene, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Woman with a Lute
items.description_narrative: A woman in a fur-trimmed yellow jacket leans toward a curtained window, tuning a lute balanced against her shoulder as if waiting for the light, or a companion, to arrive. A large wall map looms behind her in shadow.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, lute, musician, wall map, dutch golden age, metropolitan museum

items.title: Woman in Blue Reading a Letter
items.description_narrative: A woman in a loose blue jacket stands absorbed in a letter held in both hands, her lips slightly parted as she reads. A large, timeworn map fills the wall behind her, and two chairs with a cluttered table sit in shadow at the room's edge.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, letter, blue jacket, wall map, dutch golden age, rijksmuseum

items.title: Diana and her Nymphs
items.description_narrative: A seated woman in golden yellow has her foot gently washed by a kneeling companion, other women in rose and blue resting nearby with a small dog at their feet, one bare-backed figure turned away beneath a tree. Vermeer painted this scene of Diana and her nymphs in the 1650s.
items.tags: mythological painting, bathing scene, nymphs, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: The Little Street (View of Houses in Delft)
items.description_narrative: A red brick facade rises above a quiet street, its shutters half open; a woman sews in a doorway at right while two children crouch on the step nearby, and another figure bends over work in a passage at left beside a leafy tree. Vermeer painted this street view in 1658.
items.tags: street scene, brick facade, domestic life, delft, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a fur-trimmed yellow jacket lifts a length of ribbon to her collar, pearl drops glinting at her ears as she gazes toward an unseen mirror. Soft daylight falls across a bare white wall behind her, and a mustard-yellow curtain frames the window at her side.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, pearl earrings, yellow jacket, dutch golden age, daylight, gemaldegalerie berlin

items.title: Officer and Laughing Girl
items.description_narrative: A soldier in a broad black hat and scarlet coat, seen mostly from behind, leans toward a smiling young woman who holds a glass of wine between her fingers. A large wall map fills the space behind her, depicting Holland and West Friesland.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, soldier, wine glass, courtship, wall map, dutch golden age, interior light

items.title: The Music Lesson
items.description_narrative: A woman in a black bodice stands at a keyboard instrument with her back turned, while a man in dark dress looks on beside her. Above them a gilt-framed mirror catches a faint reflection of the sunlit room, and a viola da gamba lies abandoned on the black-and-white tiled floor.
items.tags: genre scene, music lesson, virginal, interior, mirror, dutch golden age, checkered floor, vermeer

items.title: The Love Letter
items.description_narrative: Framed by an open doorway, a woman holding a cittern looks up at a maid who presents her with a letter, a laundry basket and broom left on the checkered floor and a small seascape hanging among the paintings behind them. Vermeer painted this scene in 1668.
items.tags: letter delivery, doorway, musician, interior scene, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: The Astronomer
items.description_narrative: A man in a loose patterned robe leans across a table draped in a richly woven cloth, reaching to touch a celestial globe, window light falling across his face and hands. Vermeer painted this study of an astronomer around 1664.
items.tags: interior scene, celestial globe, window light, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid
items.description_narrative: A seated woman writes at a table draped in patterned red cloth while her maid stands behind, arms folded, gazing toward a curtained window; a large, dark painting of several figures hangs on the wall above them. Vermeer painted this scene in 1670.
items.tags: letter writing, maid, interior scene, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: The Procuress
items.description_narrative: A man in black raises a glass and grins out at the viewer while, beside him, another in a red coat and feathered hat curls an arm around a young woman in butter-yellow, a coin seemingly passing between the figures. A patterned rug and a blue-and-white jug crowd the table below the scene's flushed, candlelit intimacy.
items.tags: genre scene, vermeer, tavern, coins, wine glass, dutch golden age, jug, figures

items.title: Girl Reading a Letter at an Open Window
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a gold bodice reads intently by an open window, its red curtain drawn back, a heavy green drape framing the room and a bowl of fruit spilling across a patterned cloth in the foreground. Vermeer painted this quiet scene in the 1650s.
items.tags: interior scene, letter reading, window light, still life, vermeer, dutch golden age

items.title: A Lady Writing
items.description_narrative: A woman in a fur-trimmed yellow jacket pauses mid-sentence, quill in hand, small bows gathered in her hair and a dark, indistinct painting hanging on the wall behind her. Vermeer painted this scene in the 1660s.
items.tags: letter writing, interior scene, quill pen, yellow jacket, vermeer, dutch golden age
items.credit_line: eAG0Jvulh617uw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
items.description_narrative: A woman leans in to offer a basket of bread while a seated figure gazes up, chin resting on her hand, listening to a robed man who gestures gently as he speaks. Vermeer painted this biblical scene between 1654 and 1655.
items.tags: biblical scene, interior, figures, vermeer, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Portrait of Jacobus Zaffius
items.description_narrative: An elderly man with a full white beard and moustache wears a black cap and a heavy fur-collared cloak, a small coat of arms painted on the wall behind him.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, elderly man, fur-trimmed cloak, coat of arms, dutch golden age, black cap

items.title: Portrait of Maritge Claesdr Vooght
items.description_narrative: An elderly woman sits with a large clasped book braced against her lap, one hand resting on its cover and the other draped over the arm of her chair. A gold-and-black coat of arms hangs on the wall above her shoulder, and her wide pleated ruff and starched cap catch the room's low light.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, elderly woman, seated, coat of arms, book, dutch golden age, ruff collar

items.title: Portrait of Jacob Olycan
items.description_narrative: A young man in an elaborately patterned black doublet with slashed sleeves stands with one hand resting confidently at his hip, his broad ruff and delicate cuffs catching crisp white light. He is identified as Jacob Pietersz Olycan.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, young man, black doublet, ruff collar, dutch golden age, jacob olycan, mauritshuis

items.title: Catharina Hooft and her Nurse
items.description_narrative: A smiling woman in a starched white cap and wide ruff holds up a small golden rattle for a richly dressed child beside her, the child's bonnet and gown embroidered in gold thread and trimmed with fine lace. Frans Hals painted this double portrait around 1619.
items.tags: portrait, mother and child, lace ruff, frans hals, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Family Portrait in a Landscape
items.description_narrative: A woman in a stiff lace ruff turns with a warm smile toward a young girl beside her, whose own lace-trimmed bonnet and collar catch the light against a dark, wooded backdrop. Frans Hals and Salomon de Bray worked on this family portrait between about 1623 and 1628.
items.tags: family portrait, lace collar, dutch golden age, frans hals, oil on canvas, mother and daughter

items.title: Portrait of Pieter Cornelisz van der Morsch
items.description_narrative: An older man with windswept grey hair and a wide ruffled collar holds up a silvery fish, gripping it firmly by the tail as he turns with a faint, knowing smile.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, fish, ruff collar, older man, dutch golden age, genre portrait, grey hair

items.title: Banquet of the Officers of the St. George Civic Guard
items.description_narrative: A mustached man in a broad, starched ruff cuts into a piece of meat with a knife, seated close among fellow guardsmen in plumed hats and gold-trimmed coats at a laden table. Frans Hals painted this banquet scene in 1627.
items.tags: group portrait, feast, ruff collar, frans hals, dutch golden age, oil on canvas
items.credit_line: Own work Sailko Taken on 17 March 2017

items.title: Officers and Sergeants of the St. George Civic Guard
items.description_narrative: Rendered in loose, confident brushwork, an officer in black with a wide lace collar and a broad orange sash turns to look past the viewer, one gloved hand raised near his chest. Behind him another guardsman in matching black leans in, mustache curling into an easy smile.
items.tags: group portrait, civic guard, frans hals, orange sash, militia, lace collar, dutch golden age, loose brushwork

items.title: Portrait of an Elderly Lady
items.description_narrative: An elderly woman in a dark, fur-trimmed gown wears a pointed white diadem cap and a crisp pleated ruff, a small red book held in one weathered hand.
items.tags: portrait, elderly woman, diadem cap, frans hals, book, dutch golden age, fur trim

items.title: The Meagre Company
items.description_narrative: A long row of militia guardsmen in black coats and crisp white ruffs stand shoulder to shoulder with pikes and halberds, one figure in gold-trimmed white at the far left gesturing broadly beside a man in a wide black hat and orange sash. Frans Hals began this civic guard portrait in the 1630s and Pieter Codde completed it.
items.tags: group portrait, militia, civic guard, pikes, frans hals, dutch golden age

items.title: Fisherman Playing the Violin
items.description_narrative: A weathered, gray-haired man grins broadly as he draws a bow across his violin, a white ruff at his throat and the ruins of a stone tower rising behind him against a pale sky. Frans Hals painted this smiling violinist around 1630.
items.tags: portrait, violinist, smiling, ruined tower, frans hals, dutch golden age
items.credit_line: Own work Francesco Bini Taken on 22 February 2022

items.title: Two Boys Singing
items.description_narrative: Two boys open their mouths in song, one leaning close to guide the other's tune. This workshop production, attributed to the circle of Frans Hals, is dated to around 1626. A boisterous, unpolished energy marks the pair's shared performance.
items.tags: genre painting, children, singing, music, dutch golden age, oil on canvas

items.title: Portrait of a Man with a Skull
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a black doublet with a stiff lace ruff turns to meet the viewer's eye while cradling a human skull in his palm. Faint lettering and a small coat of arms are inscribed on the wall behind him, adding a sober note to the portrait.
items.tags: portrait, memento mori, skull, frans hals, lace ruff, dutch golden age, vanitas

items.title: Saint Luke the Evangelist
items.description_narrative: A balding, bearded man in white and red robes leans over a large open book, quill in hand, an ox's horned head emerging from the shadows beside him.
items.tags: portrait, evangelist, frans hals, religious art, dutch golden age, writing, ox

items.title: Portrait of Vincent Laurensz van der Vinne
items.description_narrative: A man with loose, shoulder-length dark hair turns to meet the viewer's gaze, a plain white collar and a touch of lace at his throat standing out against his olive-toned coat. He is identified as Vincent van der Vinne.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, young man, lace collar, small portrait, dutch golden age, vincent van der vinne

items.title: The Lute Player
items.description_narrative: A young man in a striped red and black cap grins up and to the side, plucking a lute with an exuberant, almost theatrical expression. Frans Hals painted this lively figure around 1623.
items.tags: musician, lute, jester, smiling, frans hals, dutch golden age

items.title: Portrait of a Standing Woman
items.description_narrative: A woman in deep burgundy velvet and a black overgown stands with a gold chain looped between her fingers, her lace-edged ruff and sheer cap catching soft light against a dark background.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, standing woman, burgundy velvet, ruff collar, gold chain, dutch golden age, dark background

items.title: Saint John the Evangelist
items.description_narrative: A young man in a flowing pink robe and red cloak looks upward with parted lips, pen poised over an open book as a dark bird perches at his shoulder. He is identified as John the Evangelist.
items.tags: portrait, evangelist, frans hals, religious art, dutch golden age, red cloak, getty museum
items.credit_line: owHroCxLuYyx-A at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Fisher Boy in a Landscape
items.description_narrative: A boy in a bright red cap and a red vest under his dark jacket sits before a stretch of dunes and open sea, a woven basket slung over his shoulder, his gaze meeting the viewer with a faint, gap-toothed smile. Frans Hals painted this fisher boy around 1630.
items.tags: portrait, fisher boy, coastal landscape, red cap, frans hals, dutch golden age

items.title: Peeckelhaering
items.description_narrative: A grinning man in a plumed cap and a bright orange doublet studded with oversized buttons turns to catch the viewer's eye, one hand raised as if mid-gesture. He is identified in the collection record as a jester.
items.tags: portrait, jester, frans hals, orange costume, comic figure, dutch golden age, plumed cap

items.title: Singing Boy with a Flute
items.description_narrative: A boy in a wide feathered hat sings with his mouth open, one hand raised and fingers splayed as he grips a wooden flute in the other, an open book propped in front of him.
items.tags: genre scene, frans hals, boy, flute, feathered hat, dutch golden age, music

items.title: Portrait of Johannes Acronius
items.description_narrative: Set within a painted oval, a bearded man in a black robe and pleated ruff holds an open document, one finger raised to mark his place as he glances up from reading. He is identified as Johannes Acronius.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, oval frame, reading, ruff collar, dutch golden age, johannes acronius

items.title: Portrait of a Man
items.description_narrative: This portrait catches a mustached man in a crisp lace ruff and dark doublet, one hand extended as if mid-gesture, rendered with a close, intimate scale. It is painted in oil on a small copper support rather than canvas or panel.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, miniature, copper support, lace ruff, oval, dutch golden age, intimate scale

items.title: Portrait of a Woman Holding a Book
items.description_narrative: An elderly woman in a fur-trimmed black gown and a soft white bonnet holds a small red book in one hand, her lace-edged ruff framing a composed, direct gaze. She is identified as Maritge Claesdr Vooght.
items.tags: portrait, frans hals, elderly woman, fur trim, bonnet, book, dutch golden age, maritge claesdr vooght
